title: 第七章 错漏百出武道教头第八章 邢命御书死亡时间
content_zh:
三月初九，龙日、冲狗、煞南。
庆丰觉得今日诸事不顺，身为一城县捕，却坐在牢房之内，本就是出奇之事。
但他更不明白.......
如今明明已是三月，铁棠却在问自己二月的事情。
这让他早已准备好的一套说辞派不上用场，如同一记重拳打在了棉花之上。
“二月初二我....铁棠，这与马场凶案何干？”
“现在是你问我，还是我问你？问你什么就答什么！”铁棠紧紧盯着庆丰，没有半点放松。
“这么久的事，谁还记得？”
随口应付了一句，庆丰见铁棠面色不善，赶紧补充。
“大概是与往日一般当值，并无特殊情况。”
“今年伊始，你可曾去往其他县城？”
“当然！”
“何时？去往何地？”
“开春之际，曾与家属亲眷去往东竹城。”
“所为何事？”
“去游玩不行吗？”庆丰一脸不耐。
“之后可曾去往其他城池？”
“当然有，我可没有总捕头这么空闲，能够躲在县衙足不出户，少不得因为公务在周边出行。”
“一一道来！”
庆丰不知铁棠葫芦里卖的什么瓜，但他所问并非难题，没什么不能说的。

待到庆丰全部说完，铁棠又追问了一句：“近来可曾去过幽县？”
“幽县？”庆丰一脸茫然，想了想.....缓缓摇头。
铁棠端起墨绿茶杯，小饮了一口，一时没有再问。
“该说的我都说了，真不是我杀人，你不如先放了我，大家一起查案，我还能跑了不成？”
闻着幽幽茶香，庆丰喉咙涌动，不想在这阴暗、潮湿的牢房多待一刻。
“呵！”
铁棠轻笑一声，突然大声问道：“庆县捕，你为何一连斩首十三人，还将他们统统抛尸马场？
速速从实招来，若有半分虚言，刑具伺候。”
“铁棠！！！”庆丰气得三尸暴跳，一下从地上站了起来。
“案发时间，昨夜至今日辰时，你身在何处？”
尽管气得不行，但庆丰早已打好腹稿，快速回应。
“这段时间，庆某自是在家中就寝，还能去往何处？”
“你的秋水雁翎刀呢？”
content_en:
On the ninth day of the third lunar month, the dragon sun, the dog, and the evil spirit south.
Qingfeng felt that everything was not going well today. As a city and county arrestee, it was strange to be sitting in a cell.
But he doesn't understand even more...
Now it is clearly March, but Tie Tang is asking himself about February.
This made the rhetoric he had prepared useless, like a heavy punch hitting cotton.
"On the second day of February, I...Tie Tang, what does this have to do with the murder at the racecourse?"
"Are you asking me now, or am I asking you? Just answer whatever I ask you!" Tie Tang stared at Qingfeng closely, not relaxing at all.
"Who still remembers what happened so long ago?"
After making a casual remark, Qingfeng quickly added something when he saw Tie Tang's unkind expression.
"I'm probably on duty as usual, there are no special circumstances."
"Have you ever traveled to other counties at the beginning of this year?"
"Of course!"
"When? Where to go?"
"At the beginning of spring, I went to Dongzhu City with my family members."
"Why?"
"Can't we go on a trip?" Qingfeng looked impatient.
"Have you ever gone to other cities since then?"
"Of course, I don't have as much free time as the chief police officer. I can hide in the county office without leaving home, and I rarely travel around for official duties."
"Come one by one!"
Qingfeng didn't know what kind of melons were sold in Tietang Gourd, but what he asked was not a difficult question and there was nothing he couldn't say.
After Qingfeng finished everything, Tie Tang asked again: "Have you been to You County recently?"
"Youxian?" Qingfeng looked confused, thought for a while... and slowly shook his head.
Tie Tang picked up the dark green tea cup, took a sip, and didn't ask any more questions for a while.
"I've said everything that needs to be said. It's really not me who killed the person. Why don't you let me go first and let's investigate the case together. Can I still run away?"
Smelling the faint fragrance of tea, Qingfeng's throat surged, and he didn't want to stay in this dark and humid cell for a moment longer.
"Ha!"
Tie Tang chuckled and suddenly asked loudly: "Qing County arrester, why did you behead thirteen people in a row and dump them all on the horse farm?
Quickly call for truth, if there is even half a lie, torture instruments will be at your service. "
"Tietang!!!" Qingfeng was so angry that the three corpses jumped up and stood up from the ground.
"When the crime occurred, from last night to today, where were you?"
Although he was extremely angry, Qingfeng had already prepared a plan and responded quickly.
"During this period, Qing is sleeping at home, where else can he go?"
"Where is your Qiu Shui Yan Fei Dao?"
